instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot, eye-level. Inside a spacious motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls, two people are interacting. On the left, the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) lunges forward, extending her right arm to punch the left shoulder of the bearded man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1). The man (R1) stands on the right, facing away from the camera, absorbing the strike. The background shows dark partitions and studio equipment under bright, even overhead fluorescent lighting.
elements: R2 lunges forward and extends her right arm to punch R1's left shoulder
R1 absorbs the strike from R2 rather than striking R2
R2 is the active puncher while R1 is the receiving target
R1 faces away from the camera while receiving contact from R2
The contact point is R1's left shoulder
